# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 25 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Radius — 2 tokens; Gradient — 5 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--background, oklch(0.07 0.007 50));
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: oklch(0.07 0.007 50);
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--background` | oklch(0.07 0.007 50) | shadcn: page background. Same value as color-fob-950. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--color-fob-950, oklch(0.07 0.007 50));
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: oklch(0.07 0.007 50);
```

### Tokens (25)

| token | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--color-fob-950` | oklch(0.07 0.007 50) | Page ground: body background, scrollbar track, and the dark text on amber fills (primary-foreground). The deepest amber-tinted surface, never pure black. |
| `--color-fob-900` | oklch(0.11 0.010 50) | Raised surface one step up from the ground: cards and popovers. |
| `--color-fob-800` | oklch(0.16 0.013 50) | Quiet fills: secondary/muted/accent backgrounds, form inputs, the regular-price ticket chip. |
| `--color-fob-700` | oklch(0.22 0.016 50) | Hairline borders and dividers between event rows and page sections. Decorative only (1.2:1 on fob-950); never the only cue for a control's edge. |
| `--color-fob-600` | oklch(0.30 0.018 50) | Highest surface step; defined in the theme, rarely used directly. |
| `--color-fob-text` | oklch(0.94 0.010 75) | Primary text and headings on every fob surface (17.5:1 on fob-950, 14.6:1 on fob-700). |
| `--color-fob-subtle` | oklch(0.67 0.010 65) | Secondary text: locations, descriptions, instrument labels, month abbreviations. 7.0:1 on fob-950, 5.8:1 on fob-700. |
| `--color-fob-muted` | oklch(0.42 0.008 55) | Tertiary meta (years, times, the scroll cue). Fails body contrast: 2.5:1 on fob-950. Kept exact from the source; don't use it for anything a visitor must read. |
| `--color-fob-gold` | oklch(0.83 0.155 72) | The brand's lightest warm accent: date numerals, page titles, outline-button labels, the presale chip, hover state of event titles. 11.9:1 on fob-950. |
| `--color-fob-amber` | oklch(0.72 0.170 50) | Core accent: the section-title rule, button borders (40% at rest, 100% on hover), 10–12% tints behind hovered controls, focus rings. 8.0:1 on fob-950. |
| `--color-fob-copper` | oklch(0.58 0.150 33) | Deepest warm accent from the logo, closing the gold → amber → copper ramp. 4.5:1 on fob-950: body-text safe only on fob-950 itself. |
| `--card` | oklch(0.11 0.010 50) | shadcn: Card surface. Same value as color-fob-900. |
| `--card-foreground` | oklch(0.94 0.010 75) | shadcn: text on card. |
| `--popover` | oklch(0.11 0.010 50) | shadcn: popover surface. |
| `--popover-foreground` | oklch(0.94 0.010 75) | shadcn: text on popover. |
| `--primary` | oklch(0.72 0.170 50) | shadcn: solid primary button fill. Same value as color-fob-amber. |
| `--primary-foreground` | oklch(0.07 0.007 50) | shadcn: text on primary (7.9:1). Dark ink on amber, never white. |
| `--secondary` | oklch(0.16 0.013 50) | shadcn: secondary button fill. |
| `--secondary-foreground` | oklch(0.94 0.010 75) | shadcn: text on secondary (16.3:1). |
| `--muted` | oklch(0.16 0.013 50) | shadcn: muted fill. |
| `--muted-foreground` | oklch(0.67 0.010 65) | shadcn: secondary text, e.g. CardDescription (6.5:1 on muted). Same value as color-fob-subtle. |
| `--accent` | oklch(0.16 0.013 50) | shadcn: hover fill for ghost and outline buttons. |
| `--destructive` | oklch(0.55 0.18 25) | shadcn: destructive action fill. With destructive-foreground it reaches 4.46:1, just under AA for small text; use it at 14px bold or larger. |
| `--destructive-foreground` | oklch(0.94 0.010 75) | shadcn: text on destructive. |
| `--input` | oklch(0.16 0.013 50) | shadcn: outline-button and input border. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 88px/1.05 "Gloock", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-event-title); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-serif);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `event-title` | `.event-title`, `--text-event-title` | 88px / 1.05, letter-spacing -0.02em | 400 | `serif` | Event page h1. Fluid: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 5.5rem); 88px is the max. Ink color-fob-text. |
| `date-numeral` | `.date-numeral`, `--text-date-numeral` | 56px / 1 | 400 | `serif` | Day number in the event hero, clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.5rem). Event cards use clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem). Always color-fob-gold. |
| `page-title` | `.page-title`, `--text-page-title` | 51.2px / 1.25 | 400 | `serif` | Page h1 on inner pages, clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.2rem), in color-fob-gold. |
| `section-title` | `.section-title`, `--text-section-title` | 44.8px / 1.25, letter-spacing -0.025em | 400 | `serif` | Section h2 (SectionTitle), clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.8rem), color-fob-text, followed 16px below by a 56px × 1px color-fob-amber rule. |
| `subsection-title` | `.subsection-title`, `--text-subsection-title` | 30.4px / 1.4, letter-spacing -0.01em | 400 | `serif` | h2 inside the event page (Entradas, Horarios, Ubicación), clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 1.9rem). |
| `lede` | `.lede`, `--text-lede` | 22.4px / 1.625, italic, letter-spacing 0.01em | 300 | `serif` | Hero tagline and event descriptions, clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.4rem). Gloock ships one weight, so 300 renders as its 400; italic is synthesized. |
| `card-title` | `.card-title`, `--text-card-title` | 20.8px / 1.375 | 400 | `serif` | Event name in EventCard, clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.3rem). Turns color-fob-gold on row hover. |
| `member-name` | `.member-name`, `--text-member-name` | 20px / 1.25 | 400 | `serif` | Musician name under the portrait in BandMemberCard. |

| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 14px / 1.429 | 400 | `sans` | Supporting lines: event location, shadcn button labels. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius: 0.4rem) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius` | 0.4rem | shadcn base radius. Tailwind derives radius-sm (−1px), radius-lg (+2px) and radius-xl (+6px) from it with calc(). |
| `--radius-md` | 0.4rem | Equal to radius: the default rounding for shadcn controls. |

## Gradient

Gradients the site uses on the FOB palette. They darken or fade; none is decorative color. The old yellow → orange → red Tailwind gradients are not part of the brand.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--gradient-hero-overlay: linear-gradient(to bottom, oklch(0.07 0.007 50 / 0.95) 0%, oklch(0.07 0.007 50 / 0.65) 40%, oklch(0.07 0.007 50 / 0.65) 60%, oklch(0.07 0.007 50 / 1) 100%)) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--gradient-hero-overlay), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--gradient-hero-overlay` | linear-gradient(to bottom, oklch(0.07 0.007 50 / 0.95) 0%, oklch(0.07 0.007 50 / 0.65) 40%, oklch(0.07 0.007 50 / 0.65) 60%, oklch(0.07 0.007 50 / 1) 100%) | Over the full-bleed hero photo: amber-tinted darkness, heaviest at the top and solid at the bottom so the page ground continues. Hero.astro. |
| `--gradient-event-overlay` | linear-gradient(to bottom, oklch(0.07 0.007 50 / 0.55) 0%, oklch(0.07 0.007 50 / 0.5) 40%, oklch(0.07 0.007 50 / 0.85) 75%, oklch(0.07 0.007 50) 100%) | Over an event's cover image on the event page, lighter at the top so the photo reads, solid behind the title. |
| `--gradient-event-fallback` | linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.18 0.04 50), oklch(0.07 0.007 50)) | Stands in for an event cover when the event has no image: a faint warm glow falling into the ground. |
| `--gradient-fade-start` | linear-gradient(to right, oklch(0.11 0.010 50), transparent) | 64px edge fade on the left of the repertoire carousel, from color-fob-900 to clear. |
| `--gradient-fade-end` | linear-gradient(to left, oklch(0.11 0.010 50), transparent) | The matching fade on the carousel's right edge. |
